name: Untamed Ehizia
detailed_description:
Untamed Ehizia rediscovers the Massively Multiplayer Online genre where these three terms are at the core of the gameplay and where every aspect of the game is accompanied by social interaction.

Key features

  • Shared quests. The game has no personalized quests or storyline. All NPCs have the same global states for everyone. No in-game areas are instantiated for the player, no isolated gameplay. Every door and every switch has the same state for everyone. Players can influence the state of the world, which in turn influences other players.

  • PvE-oriented gameplay - prioritizes cooperation over conflicts. PvP is possible within specific constraints and does not serve as a means to solve conflicts of interest; rather, it serves as a tool for social interactions. At the same time, PvE challenges are not limited to combat but also have survival elements. 

  • Mob behavior variety. Various areas and mobs give new challenges, and the solutions to these challenges are not limited to player character strength but also to your ability to cooperate and develop your tactical skills.

  • Friendly non-toxic environment - with a lot of challenges that require people to unite, and with no open PvP that would make people afraid of each other. The shared state of the world is designed in a way that no one can abuse it.

  • Secret spells and abilities. Not all abilities are accessible by default with leveling, and some skills can be scarce and extremely difficult to obtain. In some circumstances, finding a person with a certain ability is important for reaching some in-game content.

  • No auto-party search, auctions, or single-click market operations. Although these features bring convenience into the game, we believe that they prevent you from seeing the human personality of other players. Instead, we have other tools, such as special advertising boards and special locations where you can find new teammates. Same for trade: contact, negotiate prices, and make all necessary interactions via conversations and direct player-to-player trade.

  • Horizontal and vertical progressions are separated. Find or unlock new skills to increase character flexibility. But new skills are not always better than the old ones unless they’re used in the correct situation. Increase character stats to progress numerically with damage.

  • Unique classes with no perfect balance between them. Every class has entirely different gameplay and unique social roles.

  • Ultimate freedom from the beginning of the game. No quest markers that guide you in the world. No game story is compulsory to complete. Create your own story with your unique adventure.

short_description: Untamed Ehizia is a sandbox MMORPG with multiple experimental game mechanics built around cooperation and social interactions. Come with friends or find new ones, and tame the world of Ehizia together.
